title: Password generator with strength estimate
when: The user wants a tool that generates strong random passwords or passphrases with options for length and character sets.
prompt:
Goal: Unbiased, cryptographically random passwords with an honest entropy estimate, never stored anywhere.
Steps:
1. Options: length range 8 to 64 with the value shown, checkboxes for lower, upper, digits, symbols and "avoid look alikes" (0 O 1 l I), all labeled.
2. Randomness only from crypto.getRandomValues with rejection sampling (discard values at or above floor(2^32 / n) x n); never Math.random.
3. Include one character from each chosen set, then Fisher Yates shuffle with the same source.
4. logic.mjs takes the random source as a parameter: generate(opts, rand), entropyBits = length x log2(pool), strength(bits): under 50 weak, 50 to 80 good, above 80 strong.
5. Passphrase mode from a local list of at least 1,000 words with a separator choice.
6. Copy with navigator.clipboard.writeText and announce "Copied" in aria-live.
7. test.mjs with a fake source: length, every set present, look alikes absent, entropy.
Quality bar:
- No modulo bias.
- No network, no storage of results.
- Strength label in words.
Pitfalls:
- Math.random.
- All sets unchecked: disable Generate and say why.
- Logging passwords to the console.
Verify:
- [ ] getRandomValues used.
- [ ] Controls labeled.
- [ ] Copy feedback live.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (generator), words.js (word list), test.mjs.

examples.output: length 20, sets checkboxes, "Strong, 128 bits", Copy, passphrase mode
